annotations.title: Albert Heijn: Add Free-Text to Shopping List

description: Add a free-text item to the Albert Heijn shopping list (no product ID needed). Use for reminders like 'verse bloemen', 'any good wine', or items not found in search. Free-text items have no quantity: put amounts in the text, e.g. '2 bossen bloemen'.

name.description: Free-text item description, e.g. 'verse bloemen', 'goede rode wijn'
